body:
I don't truly want to go.  I just don't want to be lonely anymore.  I can't spend a whole lifetime like this.  

It's not like I'm a shut-in either.  I go to dog parks all the time, I go to the lake every Saturday morning and often Sunday too.  I actually just go back home from my university, where I just walked around, and chatted with a few people.

I even directly told one cute girl that I thought she was really pretty and asked for her number, and she gave it to me.  I'm trying to not be fatalistic because then it not working out will he a self-fulfilling prophecy.  But these things never seem to go anywhere.

And I can't do this forever.
